message: 謎が謎呼ぶ転校生

name: Synn
message: 「Take this!」
I throw a paper airplane made out of an old handout straight at the space between Nanaka's eyebrows.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something like this won't work on me, crumple.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hey, Azel-chan! Wanna eat lunch together?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you add '-chan'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Cause you're a girl, duh. Right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Honorifics are unnecessary.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then how about we come up with a nickname?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel, Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, h-hey! Wait up~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-tan, A-yan, Aze-pyon, Usa-pyon, carrots, vegetable juice, health first, safety first, family safety, dream home, mortgage hell...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan. You're turning it into a word association game~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, where's Synn?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「He ran off after Azel-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」
Azel stops here and there, quietly looking around at her surroundings.
Then she starts walking again, repeating the cycle. Students passing by are chatting happily.

name: Synn
message: 「Where are you going?」

name: Synn
message: 「Want me to show you around?」
Ugh, I'm getting completely ignored.

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」
Azel was staring inside a classroom.
Inside, students had pushed their desks together and were happily eating their lunches side by side.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. I saw a friend, so I just couldn't help it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Rival! We're rivals!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you insist on sticking close?」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess because it's fun being with everyone.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you want to be with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, ah, no... You're a transfer student, and I-I-I didn't come over with any ulterior motives like that, um...」

name: Azel
message: 「Ulterior motives, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Azel
message: 「How impure.」
A shock hit me on par with the time I found out imitation crab isn't actually crab. Still, imitation crab is delicious.

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-No, you've got it wrong. I'm the Student Council President, and I want to enjoy a rosy academy life with everyone, so, um, well--」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really know how to put it, I just can't leave you alone!」

name: Azel
message: 「Leave me alone.」
I was flatly brushed off.
However, now that I've come this far, I have no choice but to press on. On my pride as Student Council President, we are eating lunch together no matter what.
With its lovely scenery, the area around the church is the perfect spot to share a friendly lunch.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you eating lunch here too, Azel? It feels really nice eating out here, doesn't it.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's noisy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is lunchtime. Can't really help that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you don't have a lunch with you? If you want to buy something, there's Prier, though it's not this way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you going to eat?」

name: Azel
message: 「Eat?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gasp!? Could it be that you're on a diet or something...」
That said, looking at Azel, it really doesn't seem like she needs to be on a diet at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, s-sorry.」
Staring intently at someone's figure is pretty rude.
It doesn't seem to bother her, so I breathe a sigh of relief.

name: Synn
message: 「You really are trying to save money, aren't you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Save money?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You've got some goal in mind, so you're saving up cash, right.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is money?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... W-Well, it's something essential for living, and you get it by working or stuff... I think.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no money.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right... Foreign currency doesn't work here, huh.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not need it.」
What is this--this conversation flows in a way that makes me worry we aren't on the same page at all.
Still, hearing that she doesn't have any money makes me feel a strange sense of kinship.

name: Synn
message: 「Ugya.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. My stomach's just empty... Alright, let's have lunch right here.」
Plopping down firmly, I slowly pull out my bento box and open it.

name: Synn
message: 「Ta-da, curry bento. Looks delicious, right.」
Azel looked up at the sky.

name: Synn
message: 「You won't have any energy if you don't eat. Want some of my curry bento if you don't mind it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't hold back. I brought extra for seconds today.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's medium spicy. Even if you're bad with spicy food, I don't think it'll bother you much. I simmered it for a long time, so the veggies should be sweet and tasty.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not need it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you don't like it?」
That's weird--I thought a love for curry was universal.

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about some milk?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you drink milk, you'll grow big and strong.」

name: Azel
message: 「Big?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
W-What a rude thing for me to say while staring at her chest...!

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I definitely wasn't looking at you when I said that, Azel--」

name: Azel
message: 「They grow bigger?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... probably.」

name: Azel
message: 「They change?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, if you get proper nutrition, things might change, or they might not... but the chances of changing go up!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do they change?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's medical stuff, so I don't really know!」
Ugh, she's surprisingly latching onto this. I really want to change the subject, but... is she doing this on purpose?

name: Azel
message: 「There is no need to change.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? C-Could that mean...」

name: Azel
message: 「Such is a spirit.」

name: Synn
message: 「A s-spirit...? You are, Azel?」
A spirit... like a g-ghost? Eek, yikes~~.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, don't scare me like that. You've got proper legs and everything, there's no way you're a ghost.」

name: Azel
message: 「Talking about it is pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Let's put the scary talk aside and eat this delicious bento.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about milk.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm... Being a picky eater is such an extravagance, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「Extravagance?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! Wasting food is the height of extravagance.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Was that supposed to be funny?」

name: Azel
message: 「I live a life free of desire.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Desire?」

name: Azel
message: 「Humans have lived far too greedily.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I don't really get what you're saying...」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that right?」
Azel gazes up at the sky, spouting whatever comes to mind.

name: Azel
message: 「The view is nice.」
I try looking in the same direction Azel is staring.
A clear, bright sky. Scattered clouds drifting about, and--

name: Girl
message: 「Hauuuuu, I'm so hungryyyyy.」
I spotted a silhouette flying unsteadily at low altitude, bobbing wildly up and down.

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? What's that over there? Hey, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「--Wait, she's gone.」
Even the milk I forced on her is still sitting there. Gah, mission failed...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Found you! Now give yourself up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, this curry bento is delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Huh? Where's Azel? Why are you eating all by yourself...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I got dumped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehhhhh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even being able to invite a transfer student to lunch disqualifies me as Student Council President. I've got to work harder at this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-So it was just because you're Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, I see, that makes total sense! Way to go, Student Council President! That's our Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, want some milk?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't want it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Milk really goes best with spicy food, huh--gulp, gulp.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Paqy. You were here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Normally you'd be saying something like, 'Heh heh heh... And making everything around you all glaringly gaudy, just as expected'」

name: Synn
message: 「Sparkly, you mean. So, is something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, no... It's nothing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really? Well, if you say so.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If there's any left over, the great me wants a bento too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Too bad. I already ate it all.」
